items.docs:
Get all active orders API allows you to view all their active orders in the StockX marketplace.
An order is considered active from the time it was created to the time the product was received and authenticated by StockX and the seller is paid out.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: The start date of when the orders were created. Format is YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: toDate
params.description: The end date of when the orders were created. Format is YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: The requested page number. By default the page number is 1

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of orders to be returned. By default the number is 10
